Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled differently than standard returns.
For damaged or defective items, we cover return shipping and will issue a full refund or send a replacement. Standard returns for change of mind require you to cover the return shipping costs.
If you have your order number handy, please share it so we can get this taken care of for you!
